import java.util.Scanner;

public class EmailTransformer {
    public static String transformEmail(String emailStr) {
        int atPos = emailStr.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (atPos != -1) {
            emailStr = emailStr.substring(0, atPos) + "@" + emailStr.substring(atPos + 2);
        }
        int dotPos = emailStr.indexOf("dot", 1);
        while (dotPos != -1 && emailStr.length() != dotPos + 3) {
            emailStr = emailStr.substring(0, dotPos) + "." + emailStr.substring(dotPos + 3);
            dotPos = emailStr.indexOf("dot", 1);
        }
        return emailStr;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String email = scanner.next();
        System.out.println(transformEmail(email));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
